Titel: Interim Group Financial Controller (m/f/d)
Unternehmen: Veldhoek Logistics Group
Ort: Duisburg, Nordrhein-Westfalen, Deutschland
Quelle: LinkedIn
Link: https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/4471183520/
Abgerufen am: 24.09.2026 07:30

About the job
Veldhoek Logistics Group is a family-owned logistics provider headquartered in Rotterdam with around 4,200 employees in 11 countries. Our German holding in Duisburg bundles contract logistics and freight forwarding for the DACH region. To cover the parental leave of our Group Financial Controller, we are looking for an interim professional for approximately nine months.

What you will do
- Own the monthly close and the group reporting package for six German legal entities (HGB statutory, IFRS reporting to the Dutch parent)
- Prepare the budget 2027 and the rolling forecast together with the business unit controllers
- Analyse business performance and write the management commentary for the regional board
- Coordinate the year-end closing 2026 with the auditors
- Support the ongoing roll-out of SAP S/4HANA Finance and SAP Group Reporting at the German entities

What you bring
- Degree in business administration, finance or a comparable field
- 8+ years of experience in controlling or group reporting, ideally in logistics or services
- Solid knowledge of IFRS and HGB
- Hands-on experience with SAP FI/CO; SAP Analytics Cloud is a plus
- Fluent German and English
- Availability from November 2026

What we offer
- Engagement as a freelancer or through an interim management provider
- Hybrid set-up with at least two days per week on site in Duisburg
- Short decision paths and direct access to the regional CFO

Seniority level
Mid-Senior level

Employment type
Contract

Job function
Finance and Accounting

Industries
Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage
